title.narrative: EU-LAC Critical Raw Materials Support Action

description.narrative:
The specific objective of the contract is to support the development of strategic bilateral partnerships in LAC (primary focus on Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil and Chile). These mutually-beneficial strategic bilateral partnerships should cover the entire raw materials value chain (exploration, extraction, processing and refining).


The proposal needs to be fully aligned with the political objectives of the Commission, with the CRM Act and with objectives and roadmap of the future partnerships to be developed in the countries that are part of the geographical scope of this project.


To achieve this objective, the requested services of the contract are:


1.     Develop dialogues between EU and selected countries in Latin America and the Caribbean key stakeholders (primary focus on Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Brazil, but possibly other countries could be added) with the purpose to identify investment opportunities for EU private sector.

2.     Through a public policy angle, understand and identify needed action to promote an `enabling environment¿ and where the EU can support.

3.     Map and evaluate critical and strategic raw material value chain projects in selected countries in LAC (primary focus on Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Brazil, but possibly other countries could be added) and seek linkages with EU operators.

4.     Prepare and support 8 business missions from the EU to LAC and vice versa.
